tables.caption: Biophysical data of P1 and P2
footnotes: Peptide sequences are shown in Table 1.
The hydrophobicity order of peptides was deduced from observed tR values on a RP-HPLC at room temperature and at pH 2.

The mean [θ]222 values (in deg cm2 dmol−1) at wavelength 222 nm were measured at RT under benign conditions (100 mM KCl, 50 mM PO42−, pH 7.4), in benign buffer containing 50% TFE and in SDS micelles using circular dichroism spectropolarimeter.

The helical content (helix percentage) of a peptide relative to the molar ellipticity value of peptide P1/P2 in benign conditions (100 mM KCl, 50 mM PO42−, pH 7.4) in benign buffer containing 50% TFE and in SDS micelles.

db_assertions.db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (68%) to LL-25 K: 40%, F: 15%. Activity: active against S. aureus (MIC 30 ug/ml), B. subtilis (MIC 20 ug/ml), E. coli (MIC 32 ug/ml), and P. aeruginosa (MIC 20 ug/ml). Structure: random coil in buffer and helical in TFE or SDS. In vitro toxicity: not hemo.lytic till 100 uM.
